name: gamenet_handle_pkt13_effect_anim_activation_record
description: GameNet::HandlePkt13_EffectAnimActivationRecord receives a pkt13 activation-record payload, skips duplicates, and suppresses echo while processing new records.
known_limits: The smoke target covers duplicate skip and missing-record processing with suppression reset. Full successful zEffect command dispatch is covered by the accepted zEffect activation-record dependencies.
tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet/zEffect activation-record source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4343f0 validates using the packet payload at offset 0x08 as the zEffectAnimActivationRecord, calling HasActivationRecord, setting g_GameNetSuppressPkt13ActivationEcho to 1 only around ProcessActivationRecord for new records, clearing the suppress flag afterward, skipping duplicate records, and returning 1.
The native pkt13 handler smoke verifies the handler returns 1 and resets suppression after processing a missing record, then returns 1 without changing suppression when the record is already queued.
